title: One country spends 15% of its economy on school. Top 5 education 2022
description: Which country spends the biggest share of its economy on education? Number one will surprise you. Real World Bank data (government education spending, % of GDP, 2022), counted down from five to one.
source: World Bank, government expenditure on education (% of GDP, 2022, 164 countries with 2022 data), data.worldbank.org/indicator/SE.XPD.TOTL.GD.ZS; dollars per person via NY.GDP.PCAP.CD

segments.text: One country spends almost fifteen percent of its whole economy on education. Can you guess which?

props.kicker: Spent on education, share of the economy

segments.text: Top five. Number five is the Solomon Islands. Eight and a half percent.
Number four is Namibia. Over nine percent.
Number three is Vanuatu. Almost eleven percent.
Number two has fewer than ten thousand people. Tuvalu. Almost fourteen percent.
And number one is Kiribati. Almost fifteen percent. A tiny economy has to run schools on thirty-three islands.
And it keeps climbing. In 2023 Kiribati hit sixteen percent.
But that is only about three hundred dollars per person. Germany spends almost nine times more.
How much does your country spend on school? Follow for more money, mapped.
